name: outlook-teams-booking
description: Self-hosted booking API for Microsoft 365. Visitors book Teams meetings straight into your Outlook calendar from any website. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

MS_TENANT_ID.description: Directory (tenant) ID from your Entra app registration.

MS_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID from your Entra app registration.

MS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret value from your Entra app registration.

MAILBOX.description: The mailbox whose calendar takes the bookings, e.g. you@yourdomain.com.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Public, sent to your sites so they can show the widget.

SIGNING_KEY.description: Any long random string. Signs the cancel and reschedule links.
